title: feat(objectql,cli,metadata-protocol): backfill the currency code of rows stored before an amount switched to record mode, and acknowledge the switch with a 409 at the save
body:
epic:#8345#1 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbTZrFqRYNgjSaSbN5

<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg9xV1B9ukhcbUkqcsAi8vpW)_

Fixes #27577
Ruling-ref: 6492000994
⛔ lands before R2 (#27191 / #27192 / #27193). Not release-paired: ships in the next Version Packages.

Clause-②: yes (widening) — a new `@objectstack/objectql` export (`backfillRecordCurrencyCodes` and its report helpers), a new command `os migrate record-currency-codes`, and a new finding `currency_mode_to_record` registered in the existing 409 `destructive_change` face, lifted by its existing `force`
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** 已有数据的 `dynamic` / `fixed` 金额字段切到 `record` 后，旧行有金额无币种码。新增显式回填 `os migrate record-currency-codes --object --field --code`：只给「有金额、码为空」的行写运维给的码，默认只报告，`--apply` 才写，可重复跑；元数据保存这种切换时返回现有 409 `destructive_change`（finding `currency_mode_to_record`），点名三个后果和命令，`force` 放行。
- **为什么改：** 不回填，这些行显示为纯数字、分组落进 null 组、币种筛选看不到，R2 合并会漏算。
- **风险与回滚：** 码从不推断；有码的行从不改；非 ISO 4217 码在读任何行前拒绝；写入走 `engine.update`，受 R1 写入守卫与 `valueDomain` 判；409 不读数据行、不加启动拒绝。回滚即撤 PR。
- **先看：** `packages/objectql/src/record-currency-backfill.ts`，再看 `protocol.ts` 里 `detectDestructiveObjectChanges` 新增的一段。
- **两分钟验证：** 跑 `record-currency-backfill.test.ts`（干跑、写入、幂等、有码不动、空金额跳过、坏码拒绝）与 `protocol-destructive-currency-mode.test.ts`（dynamic/fixed→record 返回 409、新字段不触发、`force` 放行）。
- **需要您做的：** 无，已裁 B；本 PR 不触及受治理路径，skills 一行与 ADR 开放项由 epic PM 另开 Tier H PR。

## What changes

**`@objectstack/objectql` — `backfillRecordCurrencyCodes(engine, logger, { object, field, code, apply, maxRecords })`** (`record-currency-backfill.ts`, modelled on `summary-backfill.ts`), exported with `formatRecordCurrencyBackfillReport` and `recordCurrencyBackfillComplete`.

- Before any row is read: the object must resolve (`OBJECT_NOT_FOUND` / 404, `objectNotFoundError`), the field must be a `record`-mode `currency` field (`recordCurrencyFieldOf`, the write guard's own reading; else `INVALID_FIELD` / 400 naming the field), and the code must be an `iso_4217_currency` member (`isValueDomainMember`, the predicate the code field's `valueDomain` uses, exact spelling, no trim or case fold; else `INVALID_FIELD` / 400 naming the code field). Each refusal ends "Refused before the walk read or wrote any row."
- The walk: a keyset walk over `id` reading `id`, the amount and the code, under the unscoped system context (`{ isSystem: true }`, as every `os migrate` data run). Per row, in this order: a code that is not blank → `skippedCodePresent`, never written; a blank amount → `skippedAmountBlank`; otherwise `codeless`, and on `--apply` one write. "Blank" is `isRecordCurrencyBlank` (absent, `null`, or white space only), now exported from `validation/record-currency-code.ts` so the backfill and the write guard judge one predicate: the rows filled are exactly the rows the guard would refuse on their next write of the pair. An amount of `0` is an amount.
- ⛔ The code is the caller's, never derived: nothing reads `defaultCurrency`, `localization.currency` or any other source (ADR-0144 D8 rule 4).
- Dry run unless `apply`. Idempotent: every write turns a blank code into a member code, so a second run counts zero `codeless`. One row's failure is recorded in `failures` and the walk continues; `maxRecords` (default 100 000) truncates and says so. No `sys_migration` flag.

**Why `engine.update`, not a driver write** (the card leaves this to the precedent picked): `summary-backfill.ts` itself writes through `engine.update` with the system context, as do `comment-parent-pair`, `activity-changed-fields`, `audit-key-material`, `audit-mail-bodies` and `audit-metadata-bodies`; no `os migrate` data run writes at the driver. The engine path is also the one that already judges this exact write: the R1 guard sees the payload touch the code beside the stored amount, and the code field's `valueDomain` judges the code. A write the backfill makes is therefore one the platform would accept from any caller, audited and hooked like any other; a driver write would step around both and record nothing.

**`@objectstack/cli` — `os migrate record-currency-codes --object <o> --field <amount> --code <ISO> [--apply] [--yes] [--json] [--force] [--max-records] [--database-url]`** (`commands/migrate/record-currency-codes.ts`). The shell of `os migrate summary-nulls`, one for one: SQLite occupancy gate, `--yes` for a non-interactive apply, read-only boot for the dry run (`deferSchemaDdl` + `readOnlyProbe`), the "no app objects loaded" refusal, `refuseUndeclaredObjects` for `--object`, the journal-mode note after the dry-run line and after an `INVALID_FIELD` refusal on a SQLite file, `--json` envelope with `errorCodeFields`, exit 1 on any failure. `--object`, `--field` and `--code` are required. Everything else is the engine function's.

**`@objectstack/metadata-protocol` — `detectDestructiveObjectChanges` gains `currency_mode_to_record`** (Phase 3a-destructive, `saveMetaItem`): the previous field is stored, its `currencyConfig.currencyMode` is not `record` (an absent config is the default `dynamic`), and the next field is a `currency` field with `currencyMode: 'record'`. The finding answers as the existing 409 `DESTRUCTIVE_CHANGE` with the existing `force` remedy; its message names the code field, the three consequences (plain number, the `null` group, outside every currency-paired filter) and the command with `--object` and `--field` filled in. It reads no row, like `field_type_change` and `field_required_no_default`. A new field declared in `record` mode, a field already in `record` mode, and a move out of `record` raise nothing. ⛔ No boot-time refusal: the gate runs only where a previous version exists (REST `PUT /meta`, Studio, package publish).

**Not in this diff** (governed paths, kept with the epic PM's Tier H PR per the card): the `skills/**` line and the ADR-0144 open item with its dated note. The epic PM also adds the blank-code class to #27193. #27193's code is not touched.

**Declarations, confirmed against the tree.** `Clause-②: yes (widening)`: new exports and a new command widen the public face; the finding is a new member of the existing `destructive_change` refusal face, which is the reading the card and ruling take from #27339's review 6490309706. One thing for the contract review to weigh: a save of exactly this switch that succeeded without `force` now answers 409 until re-sent with `force`; it is a risk acknowledgement on an existing face, not a refusal of what an author can write, so `Metadata-protocol: none` (every body that saved still saves). One changeset, `patch` for all three packages.

## Why

Ruling 6492000994 on #8345 (letter B): the switch is allowed and owes an explicit, audited backfill, and the R2 home projection cannot convert a codeless row, so this lands before R2.

## Verification

Head `1636d8c3`: the branch's four commits on `1ed33609` (all four R1 PRs on `main`) plus a merge of `main` at `549203d0` (including #27991), no conflicts. After the merge: `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm build` (whole workspace), then everything below on that head.

- `packages/objectql`: `record-currency-backfill.test.ts` 8 / 8 (dry run counts every kind of row and writes nothing; `--apply` fills only the codeless rows through the engine, `0` and white-space codes included, codes and amounts otherwise untouched; idempotent; five non-member codes refused with no read; three non-record fields refused with no read; unknown object `OBJECT_NOT_FOUND`; one failed write isolated, re-run finishes it; the dry-run report text). `protocol-destructive-currency-mode.test.ts` 7 / 7 (dynamic, fixed and unset → record: 409 with the finding, the message's three consequences and command, and no data read of the object; `force` lifts it; a new record-mode field, record → record, and record → dynamic / fixed raise nothing). `protocol-destructive.test.ts` 7 / 7 unchanged.
- `packages/cli`: `record-currency-codes.test.ts` 9 / 9 (dry run default; the three flags required and `--code` missing refused; names handed through; `--apply --yes`; undeclared object refused before the backfill; a real `INVALID_FIELD` code refusal reaches the `--json` envelope with `httpStatus`; the dry-run line with the journal-mode note on SQLite and without it on PostgreSQL).
- `pnpm --filter` typecheck: `@objectstack/objectql`, `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`, `@objectstack/cli` pass (test-typecheck ledgers held). eslint on every touched file: clean.
- **Ablations** (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, mutation landed and restored byte-identical each time):
  1. the backfill's code-present test `if (!isRecordCurrencyBlank(row[codeField]))` → `if (false && …)`: 5 / 8 red (rows holding EUR and JPY overwritten).
  2. the same test → `row[codeField] != null` (a null-only blank): 4 / 8 red (the white-space code row skipped as "present").
  3. the finding's condition → `false && …` (metadata-protocol rebuilt under the mutation): the three 409 cases red, 3 / 7; the four non-firing cases stay green, as they must.
- Full suites on `1636d8c3`: `@objectstack/objectql` 496 files / 9615 tests passed; `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` 284 files / 21857 passed (26 skipped, pre-existing); `packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/` 59 files / 429 passed (8 skipped, pre-existing).
- Derived gates: `dispatch-gates --commands` on `1636d8c3` derives 65 families (9 paths vs merge base `549203d0`, 1254 changed lines); each ran with its exit captured before any pipe, all 65 exited 0. `dispatch-gates --ran` reads: "65 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 65 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED". On an earlier head, `check:objectql-double-limit` caught the backfill test's driver double counting reads inside `find` (its probe could not drive it); the count moved to spies beside the double (`3c340f77`).

**CI.** Head `5d2f5efd`: 35 check runs success, 13 skipped (path-filtered), none failed; `mergeable_state: clean`. Two reds on the way there, both this PR's own and fixed:
- `check:error-code-casing` (not in the path-derived list) read the test's `{ code: 'currency_mode_to_record' }` as a lowercase `error.code` emission; the test now reads the raised finding codes as a list (`0f5c7f1f`). A destructive-change finding code is the issue's own field-addressed vocabulary, as `field_type_change` is.
- Test Core: two CLI rosters that discover their members from the tree (`test/migrate-confirmation-exit.pin.test.ts`, `src/utils/schema-migrate.one-shot-family.integration.test.ts`) did not yet name the new command; both rows added (`5d2f5efd`). The one-shot fixture declares no record-mode amount, so its two cases reach the boot and then the backfill's `INVALID_FIELD` refusal, the same shape as the `resume` and `plugin trust revoke` rows. Full `@objectstack/cli` suite locally: 535 files / 6680 tests passed (9 skipped, pre-existing).
